chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Salman (may God have mercy on him) used to say: Spread the greeting (salam) of God, for the greeting of God does not reach the unjust.

key_terms.أَفْشُوا: Spread openly, publicize, disseminate — an imperative commanding the active promotion of the greeting
key_terms.الظَّالِمِينَ: The unjust, wrongdoers, oppressors — those who transgress the rights of God or creation
key_terms.سَلَامَ اللَّهِ: The greeting/peace of God — a divine gift of peace that is transmitted through the Islamc greeting

ai.seo_question: What did Salman al-Farsi say about spreading the greeting of peace in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) reports that Salman al-Farsi, the revered companion of the Prophet, used to exhort people to openly spread the greeting of peace (al-salam). The hadith contains a profound theological dimension: the divine greeting of peace is a spiritual reality that cannot be received by those who commit injustice (zulm). For the early Muslim community, this hadith situated the simple act of greeting within a framework of moral accountability — only those with clean hearts and just conduct could truly receive and transmit God's peace.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Abdul Rahman Bin abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘It was so that Salman<sup>as</sup> was saying: ‘Offer the Greeting (السَّلَامُ) of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> openly, as for the Greeting (السَّلَامُ) of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> cannot be attained by the unjust’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ‘Abd al- Rahman ibn abu Najran from ‘Asim ibn Hamid from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Salman, May Allah grant him favors, would say, ‘Offer the greeting of peace from Allah openly; the unjust do not receive the greeting of peace from Allah.’”
